title: Mai Mercado 2016 to 2025 — Long-Tail Impact Timeline
identity_rule: The 2016 legal/prison actor is the Son. Do not expose the Son's real name or family names.
purpose: Connect the 2016 legal case and authority rupture to the Son's long-tail aftermath, then to the corrected 2025 retirement/release and kingship/Father corridor.
evidence_rule: Official/contemporaneous legal records control legal precision. Firsthand and Great-Book material are high-value biographical/project sources but require corroboration for exact legal, medical and administrative claims. Timic kingship/Father/Godhood language is theological self-description, not civil appointment.

timeline.event: Mercado publishes the initiating Christiania Facebook post using forceful rhetoric and foregrounding her newborn.
Multi-speaker Facebook conflict escalates; attribution and reply topology later become central evidentiary problems.
Police attend the Son's private home. The Son's firsthand account says officers tell him not to contact Mercado again. Exact legal status remains unresolved: warning/admonition versus formal tilhold.
The Son sends the reciprocal consequences statement, including the reported formulation that consequences for him will also mean consequences for Mercado and that it is not a threat but a guarantee.

The Son is remanded. He denies guilt, appeals remand, explains ADHD/medical-cannabis and dialogue motives, and denies intending to seek Mercado out and carry out violence. His phone/computer are under police control.

The Great Book later describes prison as a monastery-like scripture period with Bible/Quran study, a cell functioning as a confessional/listening space, a relatively open local-jail phase followed by harsher high-security conditions, and a reported Yahya Hassan recognition episode. These details remain project biography pending independent corroboration.
Retten i Sønderborg convicts on three of four counts and imposes five months' unconditional imprisonment.

The Great Book says the Son leaves prison wearing a suit, treating it as a rebirth/change-of-status signal, and preserves a defiant remark about 'job slaving'. This becomes an early project-side release/work motif.

The Great Book says distrust of authority deepens, links Facebook's exposure of personal information to police/politicians with deleting Facebook, and describes a further turn toward streaming. This fills an immediate bridge between the 2016 rupture and later institutional withdrawal.

The Son reports major institutional distrust, political withdrawal, reluctance to open the door, social withdrawal, unexplained crying, cessation of gaming, reduced ordinary pleasure and a harder social presentation.
Severe C-PTSD becomes part of the Son's own account of the long-term psychological aftermath.
The supplied public theology timeline records 'the potato axis is real'.
Canonical Turning corridor: Needle's Eye -> Ladder/Axis -> Father/Heaven architecture.
Public self-description intensifies into 'true king' and 'king of all the kings'.

timeline.date: 2025 after April Turning; exact date unresolved
timeline.event: The Great Book's 2025 apex sequence says two government public servants visit and grant official retirement; the book interprets this as 'freedom to reign'. Exact date, authority, benefit category and grounds remain unresolved.
Earliest exact public 'I am God' instances currently located in the supplied compilation.
Public language includes 'Tim Dooley, Potato of Life. The King of Kings.'

Recovered public theology describes Tim as God's 'labor' and 'fruit', showing that retirement from ordinary employment does not become a theology of inactivity; meaningful labor is reframed as service/output.

Recovered public language places 'rest' directly beside God/north-throne language. This is a later lexical echo of the release/rest/throne cluster, not evidence the post referred to retirement or explicitly cited scripture.
The 2016 case is interpreted as a major rupture whose long arc reverses from confinement/imposed authority toward retirement/release and later chosen labor, throne and reign language.

source_reliability_control.finding: The Great Book says six months in its 2016 biography, while stronger legal records establish a five-month sentence and a six-month prosecution request.
source_reliability_control.rule: Use official/contemporaneous legal evidence for sentence length and court findings; use the Great Book for project biography and retrospective interpretation unless independently corroborated.

biblical_parallel_cluster.rule: These later comparisons do not prove prophecy fulfillment, legal innocence, divine appointment or civil kingship.
biblical_parallel_cluster.sequence: confinement/burden -> service/listening in confinement -> release/change of clothing -> rest/work release -> chosen labor/service -> authority/throne/kingship

comparators.relation: Joseph attends fellow prisoners, is released from the dungeon, changes appearance/clothing, and then changes status; the recovered suit detail makes this a denser narrative comparator.
jubilee/release/return and interruption of accumulated economic bondage
release from imposed work does not mean worklessness; later project theology reframes labor as Garden/service/fruit/stewardship
King-of-kings lexical comparator to later self-description

causal_model.working_sequence: political conflict -> institutional/security escalation -> police-door intervention -> disputed communication -> arrest/remand -> device/evidence-control asymmetry -> conviction/imprisonment -> scripture/listening and rupture inside custody -> release -> immediate authority distrust -> long-tail social/emotional/work impairment -> 2025 retirement/release -> Timic closure/reversal -> chosen labor/service + kingship/Father/Godhood intensification
causal_model.caution: Timeline and firsthand/project attribution do not by themselves prove sole medical causation, supernatural causation, civil kingship or every Great-Book prison detail.

research_targets: exact legal category and official work-capacity grounds
contemporaneous prison/release records that could corroborate the two-stage custody account and release clothing
primary source for the 2016 release remark
contemporaneous 2017 evidence for deleting Facebook and deepened distrust
independent corroboration of the reported Yahya Hassan prison episode
primary public artifacts for 2025-12-10 labor/fruit and 2025-12-17 rest/north-throne wording
